subject: control display of helpText in sidebar panel?

messages.author: 5117fd6c9c423ce1
messages.subject: control display of helpText in sidebar panel?
parts:
I have a sidebar panel in a Shiny app that goes like this:

    
  sidebarPanel(
    tags$head(
      tags$style(type="text/css", "select { max-width: 250px; }"),
      tags$style(type="text/css", "textarea { max-width: 250px; }"),
      tags$style(type="text/css", ".jslider { max-width: 250px; }"),
      tags$style(type='text/css', ".well { max-width: 250px; }"),
      tags$style(type='text/css', ".span4 { max-width: 250px; }")
    ),
    helpText("PLEASE RUN STEPS IN ORDER"),
    helpText(""),
    textInput("strataname", '1) Enter name of stratum field FIRST:', value="strata"),
    fileInput('file1', '2) Choose .ZIP Shapefile:', multiple=TRUE,
          accept=c('binary')),
   helpText("Display now ready in 'Plot' tab..."),
   (numericInput("pts", "3) enter # of sampling points per stratum:", 0)),
    helpText("And - (optional)"),
  (numericInput("oversamppts", "enter # to OVER sample:", 0)),   
    submitButton("Fetch Points!"),
    helpText("Points now ready to view in 'View Points' tab"),
    downloadLink('downloadData', '4) click to Download Points as shapefile')
  
                   
    ),

It would be great if, in the app, the 'help text' messages did not appear until the step above it had been executed (referring to helpText messages after step 2 and 3, in particular).  Is there some clever way in which I can do that?

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: control display of helpText in sidebar panel?
parts:
Take a look at conditionalPanel and/or renderUI to control if/when inputs/outputs are shown.

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui
